title: Basic Camera Shaking for Java (BCSFJ)
description: Adds in command-controlled smooth camera shaking, unlike bedrock's built-in one, which is snappy and not natural-looking.
body:
Like the summary says, this mod is supposed to add in the `/camerashake` command! And like the name implies, makes your camera actually shake, but unlike Bedrock's camerashake command, it's **somewhat smoother**. I originally made it for my creative map for me and a couple friends, but realized, if I'm making a mod, I might as well publish it.

Credits
Me (for most of the coding, actually, make that all of the coding): https://www.youtube.com/@EchoesRealmArrow
FozuJK (for some other ideas and stuff): https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSrA6For3YejopX8pMHILmg

Note: Unlike my other mods, this was made by actually coding as I've now learned some Java.
